answer: Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. The saffron explorer shows the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the knoll binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 179 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
